name: Mob/Andrew Rae
description:
This playful line drawing features a collection of Andrews characters, animals, creatures and ghouls.

Andrew Rae is an illustrator based in London. He uses simple hand rendered line and a combination of paper, felt pens, watercolour, ipad, iMac and Wacom pads and screens to render irreverent images of characters, ghouls, robots, machines and creatures which are used in an editorial, publishing, advertising, animation and mural context. He is a regular contributor to The New York Times Magazine and has worked for many clients worldwide.

www.andrewrae.info
